b2-19-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Agreements and Rules
b2-19-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what happened at the office today. Two agreements were signed and the new rules were published.
b2-19-01.prompt: Tell Meg what was signed and what was published.
b2-19-01.target: Hoy se firmaron dos acuerdos y se publicaron las reglas nuevas.
b2-19-01.english: Today two agreements were signed and the new rules were published.
b2-19-01.canDo: I can make the verb agree with the noun after passive se.

b2-19-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Customers in a Shop
b2-19-02.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks about a shop near your home. In that shop all the customers are served very quickly.
b2-19-02.prompt: Tell Carlos how the customers are served in the shop.
b2-19-02.target: En esa tienda se atiende a todos los clientes muy rápido.
b2-19-02.english: In that shop all the customers are served very quickly.
b2-19-02.canDo: I can tell passive se, which agrees with a thing, from impersonal se, which stays singular.

b2-19-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Building Without a Name
b2-19-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about a new building near the office. It was built in 1990, and you do not know who built it.
b2-19-03.prompt: Tell Meg when the building was built and say you do not know who built it.
cues: Say you do not know who built it
b2-19-03.target: El edificio se construyó en 1990 y no sé quién lo construyó.
b2-19-03.english: The building was built in 1990 and I do not know who built it.
b2-19-03.canDo: I can leave out who did it when I use passive se.

b2-19-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Notice at the Door
b2-19-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what the notice at the door of the building says. It asks for silence and says that flats are for rent.
b2-19-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what the notice says.
cues: Say what the notice asks for
b2-19-04.target: El aviso dice que se ruega silencio y que se alquilan departamentos.
b2-19-04.english: The notice says that silence is requested and that flats are for rent.
b2-19-04.canDo: I can read and write short notices and instructions with se.

b2-19-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Lost Keys
b2-19-05.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks why you cannot open the door. You lost your keys in the street.
b2-19-05.prompt: Tell Meg what happened to your keys.
cues: Say that you lost them by accident
b2-19-05.target: Se me perdieron las llaves en la calle.
b2-19-05.english: I lost my keys in the street.
b2-19-05.canDo: I can tell reflexive, reciprocal, passive, impersonal and accidental se apart.

b2-19-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Text About a Novel
b2-19-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you read about the novel La ciudad y los perros. You read that it was published in 1963 and that it takes place in a military school.
b2-19-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what you read about the novel.
b2-19-consolidation.target: Leí que la novela se publicó en 1963 y que ocurre en un colegio militar de Lima.
b2-19-consolidation.english: I read that the novel was published in 1963 and that it takes place in a military school in Lima.
b2-19-consolidation.canDo: I can make the verb agree with the noun after passive se, and keep it singular with no noun or with personal a.
